subjects.description: A straight two-lane asphalt road with painted lane markings, lined with tall green trees and grass verges on both sides
subjects.action: The road surface and lane markings rush towards the camera and disappear below the bottom of the frame

subjects.description: Rows of tall leafy trees along both sides of the road
subjects.action: The trees grow larger as the camera approaches and sweep past the left and right edges of the frame

cinematography.camera_motion: The video is captured from a camera mounted on a car driving forward at about 50 km/h; the camera faces forward and travels continuously forward along the road (forward tracking shot)
cinematography.framing: Wide forward-facing dashcam view with the road vanishing point in the center

actions.description: The car accelerates forward; the lane markings start streaming towards the camera
The car keeps driving forward; trees on both sides pass by the camera and new trees appear from the distance

temporal_caption: Forward-facing dashcam footage from a car driving down a tree-lined road at speed: the lane markings stream under the car, the trees on both sides grow larger and sweep past the edges of the frame, and the end of the road keeps receding as the car advances.
